items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: we turned out to be excellent friends and we always had a mutual admiration society between he and I

ctx.x: No, not really, as a part of his band. The only time I ever worked with him was with the Les Hite Band out at the old Sebastian's Cotton Club, because after that, he had his own groups and he went his way and I went another way. The closest I ever got to him was, I worked under

the same manager, Joe Glazer, (PHONETIC) worked with Lionel Hampton as Louis Armstrong did, because he was under Joe Glazer also. So, we would cross paths quite often and we turned out to be excellent friends and we always had a mutual admiration society between he and I because he was such a fine guy and very comical and always had something going. Just a great man.
It was during the time that you were with Les Hite at Sebastian's Cotton Club that you said you met Duke Ellington?
